sourcedDescription: Orbinum has confirmed its airdrop. Season 1, called the Genesis Community, started on March 13, 2026, and rewards users with ORB Credits for quests, weekly streaks, referrals, and testnet activity like shielding, private transfers, unshielding, and selective disclosure.
tagline_en: Orbinum has confirmed its airdrop. Season 1, called the Genesis Community, started on March 13, 2026, and rewards users with ORB Credits for quests, weekly streaks, referrals, and testnet activity like shielding, private transfers, unshielding, and selective disclosure.

sourcedSteps.title: Connect Your Wallet and Join the Community
sourcedSteps.body: Head to the Orbinum Community dashboard and connect your wallet. This is where all your quests, credits, and referral stats live.

sourcedSteps.title: Link Your Discord, Telegram, and X Accounts
sourcedSteps.body: Verify all three social accounts on the dashboard. Linking everything unlocks a one-time signup bonus of 20 credits.

sourcedSteps.title: Add the Orbinum Testnet to Your Wallet
sourcedSteps.body: Add the Orbinum Testnet manually using Chain ID: 2700 and RPC: https://rpc-1.testnet.orbinum.io, or use the network-add prompt if the dashboard provides one.

sourcedSteps.title: Claim Testnet Tokens from the Faucet
sourcedSteps.body: Visit the Orbinum faucet and claim testnet tokens to cover gas for the on-chain quests below.

sourcedSteps.title: Complete the Daily Testnet Quests
sourcedSteps.body: Four repeatable on-chain quests are live each day: Shield: move testnet assets into a shielded pool Private Transfer: send a shielded transfer using a disclosure key Unshield: move assets back out of the shielded pool Selective Disclosure: reveal specific transaction details using a disclosure key Repeating these daily earns credits and counts toward your weekly streak.

sourcedSteps.title: Maintain a Weekly Streak
sourcedSteps.body: Stay active every ISO week to build a streak multiplier, worth up to 1.5x on testnet quest rewards. Missing a week resets the multiplier.

sourcedSteps.title: Refer Friends
sourcedSteps.body: Share your personal referral link from the dashboard. Each fully verified referral (wallet plus Discord, Telegram, and X all linked) earns 10 credits, with extra credits at referral milestones.

sourcedSteps.title: Complete Off-Chain Quests
sourcedSteps.body: The dashboard also lists off-chain tasks like follows, shares, quizzes, and submissions. These stack on top of your on-chain and referral credits.

sourcedSteps.title: Track Your Progress
sourcedSteps.body: Check the Community dashboard regularly to monitor your credits, quest completion, streak status, and referral count ahead of the snapshot.
